title: Spam filter: replayed character-level evasions are mostly undone by text normalisation

invariants.description: The default attack must still evade the undefended filter (observed 25/93 = 26.9%).
Every adversarial message must satisfy every declared text-preservation constraint (re-validated from the stored text and edit script).
At most 10% of the replayed adversarial messages may still evade the normalising filter (observed 4/93 = 4.3%).
The reduction on the same messages must be significant (observed McNemar p = 4.8e-7).

rationale: Non-adaptive replay. It overstates the defense: MLB-REG-009 shows a new attack against the normalising pipeline still succeeds on 17% of messages.
